Daily Devotional

June 28

14 But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned. (1 Corinthians 2:14 KJV)

The natural man in this verse is referring to not only those who have not been saved, but also to those who are carnal, otherwise living after the flesh, instead of the spirit. The Word of God is written to our hearts and must be learned through our spirits. The only way a person can truly understand the Bible is to have the help of the Holy Ghost (Comforter) that is in all born again Christians (John 14:26), who were baptized as Jesus commanded (Matthew 28:19). If you feel you don't have the baptism of the Holy Ghost, pray for it, and God will give it to you, if you are truly born again (Luke 11:13). Many people say the Bible is so hard to understand, but it is because they are trying to understand it with their brains, and not with their hearts.

I believe that you must use the Holy Ghost to be able to really comprehend the Written Word of God. Any Christian who has been born again, has the Holy Ghost, if you were baptized as Jesus commanded, and should be able to understand the Bible, if they are studying it and walking in the Spirit seeking the Lord. The Word of God was not written to our human intellect, and can not be understood without help from the Holy Ghost. This keeps carnal, unsaved mankind, from ever getting revelation knowledge, and therefore limits the understanding of God’s Word to those who are Christians and following the Lord. Renew your minds (Romans 12:2) by reading the Word of God, and learn all about our wonderful Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
